scope: Actor- and origin-scoped restoration of the nested public member-profile route on Android, Web/Wasm and iOS

steps: SavedStateHandle accepts only the exact actor and root or conversation origin
a Chat A snapshot is consumed rather than restored over Chat B
compileDebugKotlin and focal JVM tests passed
sessionStorage accepts only the exact actor and origin fragment
length-prefixed Unicode identifiers round-trip and malformed snapshots fail closed
UserDefaults accepts only the exact actor and origin
common failed-child Back returns to its retained parent
Intel Simulator framework and focal XCTest host passed without distribution signing

assertions: only successfully visible profiles are published to persistent storage
the snapshot contains successful parents followed by the current profile without duplicates
Back publishes the valid parent before loading it
a failed restored child keeps the exact target for Retry and returns to its retained parent on Back
superseded and failed new opens do not add phantom entries
successful private-conversation navigation consumes the profile route before leaving
explicit close, incompatible deep link, logout, actor mismatch and origin mismatch clear the snapshot
Android distinguishes two concrete conversations even though they share one destination pattern

cleanup.mode: no backend fixture, credential, push delivery or remote mutation used

limitations: This closes the durable nested public member-profile route only; scroll, drafts, editor state, media position and unrelated secondary back stacks retain their own units.
iOS verification uses the authorized Intel Simulator and an unsigned host test build; it makes no App Store, APNs or physical-device claim.
GitHub final jobs retain clean-runner integrated certification.

validationProvenance.androidAndWeb: Affected patches are 7/7 patch-id equivalent to Product SHA 78761dff5b2ebb843cada60807987681a8ae1d0e, and all affected Android/Web blobs are byte-identical; their passed focal evidence is reused.
validationProvenance.ios: The iOS common focal test, x64 framework link and two selected Xcode Simulator tests were rerun successfully at this exact Product SHA because the integrated base also changed QuataIosApp.swift.
